## 分诊定级 · 首次定级 · `security` · **p2** · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`

⚠️ 本卡自 08-30 13:08Z 起**零标签** ⇒ 对每条队列查询不可见。本轮 objectui 专场扫出。

### 判据:它是 #6799 的**另一半**,而且卡自己把界划清了

- **#6799(已完成)** 修的是**到达屏幕**的那一半:`generateColumns()` 丢掉主体读不到的列;
- **本卡**是**取数**那一半:列虽然隐藏了,字段名仍在 `$select` 里(`ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `loadSchemaAndData()` / `getSelectFields()`,~L1402,`perms.checkField` 在该路径上**从未被查询**)。

⭐ 卡把暴露条件写得很诚实,分诊照此定级:

> - 服务端**若**在投影上强制 FLS ⇒ 拒绝或省略,**无暴露**,且这是预期情形;
> - 服务端**若不**强制 ⇒ 值进入 `data`、进入网络响应,**而屏幕上没有任何列会暴露这件事发生过**。

⇒ 暴露**条件依赖后端**,所以不是 p1;但「无声」这一条使它也不是可忽略的 —— 没有任何在屏证据表明发生过。这正是纵深防御存在的形状。判 **p2 + `security`**。

### ⛔ 升级闸(执行者第一必答项,⚠️ 本席未测)

> **ObjectStack 自家的 REST 在 `$select` 投影上强制 FLS 吗?**

- **强制** ⇒ p2 成立,本卡是纵深防御,按 p2 交付;
- **不强制** ⇒ 这就是一条**现实的字段级越权读**,⇒ **立即升 p1 并回分诊**,范围与验收线重设。

⛔ 不得用「服务端应该会拦」来结案 —— 「应该」不是读数。这条必须先答,再动手。

### 范围钉死

- 只做 `getSelectFields()` 这条投影路径的 FLS 门,⛔ 不重开 #6799 已裁的 `generateColumns()` 面(维护者 2026-08-30 的裁决**有意**把范围限定在那一个函数);
- **必答项 2**:除 `columns` / `fields` 外,`$select` 还从哪些来源拼接(卡已点名 `id` 与视图读取的谓词字段)—— 用**枚举**回答;⚠️ 谓词字段尤其要看:一个主体读不到的字段被用作**过滤条件**,即使不回传也可能构成推断泄露,若确实如此 ⇒ 那是另一张卡,回分诊,⛔ 不在本单顺手做。
- 与 #6723 / #6799 同族,交叉链接已在卡上;判**不收敛**(不同层、不同函数、不同裁决范围)。

## The ruling this dispatch carries (triage, 2026-08-31 — ⛔ not re-adjudicable here)

The card was graded `security` · **p2** · `pm:queue` with the scope pinned. Quoting the two binding parts verbatim rather than paraphrasing them:

> ⛔ **升级闸(执行者第一必答项,⚠️ 本席未测)**
> **ObjectStack 自家的 REST 在 `$select` 投影上强制 FLS 吗?**
> - **强制** ⇒ p2 成立,本卡是纵深防御,按 p2 交付;
> - **不强制** ⇒ 这就是一条**现实的字段级越权读**,⇒ **立即升 p1 并回分诊**,范围与验收线重设。
> ⛔ 不得用「服务端应该会拦」来结案 —— 「应该」不是读数。这条必须先答,再动手。

> 只做 `getSelectFields()` 这条投影路径的 FLS 门,⛔ 不重开 #6799 已裁的 `generateColumns()` 面(维护者 2026-08-30 的裁决**有意**把范围限定在那一个函数)

**Answer the gate before you write code.** If the measurement comes back *not enforced*, that is a **successful delivery**: stop, report it, and the card returns to triage for re-grading at p1 with a reset scope. ⛔ Do not proceed to a fix on a p2 acceptance line under a p1 fact.

## Mandatory question 2, from the same ruling

> **必答项 2**:除 `columns` / `fields` 外,`$select` 还从哪些来源拼接(卡已点名 `id` 与视图读取的谓词字段)—— 用**枚举**回答

⚠️ And the trap it names: a field the principal cannot read being used as a **filter** may be an inference leak even when the value never comes back. If you measure that to be真, it is **another card** — report it, ⛔ do not fix it here.

## PM mechanism assumptions (test these; falsifying one is a good run)

⚠️ Everything in this block is the card's claim or mine, **not** measured by me:
- The card says the site is `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `loadSchemaAndData()` / the `getSelectFields()` closure, "around L1402". **The line number is a day old — re-derive it from the tree.**
- The card says `perms.checkField` is never consulted on that path. Verify at the site.
- The card's own three "why it is a decision" points are real and I would not want them shortcut — especially that `id` is force-added for row navigation and predicate fields are added with no column showing them, so **a naive filter breaks navigation or filtering rather than closing a hole.**

## Premise-first

The issue body is a clue, not a spec. `premise_still_valid: false` with no PR is a legitimate and often valuable delivery. Read the card's full body and **both** comments on GitHub yourself, and check the body for sanitizer truncation before relying on it.

Leave your own claim comment (your own session ID and branch) in addition to this one — this comment satisfies the assignee half only; do not touch the assignee field.

## ACCEPT — PR #7090. Escalation gate answered on branch 1 ⇒ **p2 stands**, not escalated. Landing held only on CI convergence.

`domain:ui` seat, session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`. Reviewed against GitHub and both checkouts, ⛔ not against the report's self-description.

### The escalation gate — I re-measured it rather than relaying it

The grade rested on one question, so I did not take the answer on trust. All four readings check out in the `objectstack` sibling at `origin/main`:

| claim | my reading |
|---|---|
| `predicate-guard` says the projection is deliberately unguarded | ✅ `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/predicate-guard.ts:57` — *"field is harmless because FieldMasker strips it from the result; only …"* |
| the masker **deletes** the key rather than nulling it | ✅ `field-masker.ts:184` **and** `:237` — `delete result[field]` |
| an executed end-to-end HTTP pin exists | ✅ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-fls-read-mask-strip.dogfood.test.ts` |
| the filter-oracle guard exists | ✅ `assertReadableQueryFields`, exported from `plugin-security/src/index.ts`, with its own test file |

⇒ ObjectStack **omits** the denied key. That is the ruling's branch 1 verbatim — *"a server that enforces FLS refuses or omits it — no exposure"* — so **p2 stands and this is defence-in-depth.** ⛔ Not escalated to p1.

⭐ And the close is on a **live over-the-wire pin**, not on "the server should catch it" — which is the exact reasoning the ruling forbade. The ruling asked for a reading and got one.

### ⭐⭐ The find that makes this PR worth more than its card: the gate would have been DEAD

Not named by the card, not by triage, not by my dispatch order. `/me/permissions` resolves asynchronously, so on first render the gate correctly defers — and **nothing would ever have rebuilt the projection after the policy answered**. A correct-looking gate that never runs on the only fetch most grids make.

⭐ **Ablation B is what turns that into evidence**: removing *only* the `perms.isLoaded` dependency reddens **exactly 1 of 10** pins. Nine stay green.

> ⇒ Nine pins would have reported success on a dead gate. That is the shape of the failure this lane keeps paying for, isolated and pinned rather than described.

Both ablations proved the mutation **on disk by blob hash** before running (`1de48053` → `2c565d99` for A, → `bdac2a69` for B), and proved the restore by blob equality *and* a clean `git diff HEAD`. ⛔ An editor's exit code is not evidence — a zero-hit replace exits 0. Correct method.

### Mandatory question 2 — answered, and it beat the card

Six sources, where the card named two. The three it did not name — `conditionalFormatting`, the `rowActionDefs`/`bulkActionDefs`/`actions` harvest (including **`recordIdField`**, a *non-predicate* field reference), and object-level `userActions` — are exactly the surface a gate on only the authored arms would have missed.

**The inference-leak trap: correctly measured and correctly NOT filed.** The ruling said that if a denied field used as a *filter* leaks by inference, it is another card. It was measured to be already closed server-side — `assertReadableQueryFields` answers 403 naming the field, against the caller's verbatim AST *before* RLS injection, so injected policy filters on `owner_id` are properly not caught. ⭐ Filing a card for a gap that does not exist is the failure mode on the other side of that instruction, and it was avoided with a measurement.

### Scope

✅ `generateColumns()` untouched — the 2026-08-30 ruling scoping #6799 to that one function was not reopened. ✅ File surface held to `packages/plugin-grid/src/` + changeset (3 files). ✅ The export path was checked and needed nothing, since it derives its `fields` from `generateColumns()` and inherits the render-half gate.

### Spot-checks on the diff itself

✅ `id` survives structurally — `ensureId` composes *after* the gate on both arms, so it cannot drift out of one. That is the card's decision point 2, answered in the composition rather than a branch.
✅ The `hasOwnProperty` read rather than a truthiness read, so `constructor` / `toString` cannot be mistaken for a declared field.
✅ PIN 8 pins that an unanswered policy filters *nothing* — a grid with no `PermissionProvider` keeps working.

⚠️ One cosmetic inconsistency, ⛔ not blocking and ⛔ not worth a round trip: the gate reads `perms?.isLoaded` (implying `perms` may be nullish) while the dependency array reads `perms.isLoaded` (which would throw if it were). `usePermissions()` always returns an object, so the dep array is the correct one and the `?.` is redundant. Noted so the next reader does not infer a nullable `perms` from it.

### Your open question — **PM ruling: A, and no card for C**

Accept and document the async window. **B is measurably wrong** and you showed why: `isLoaded` is `false` forever with no provider, so blocking the fetch would hang every unhosted grid. Against ObjectStack the residual is nil by your own gate measurement — the server strips regardless — so the window costs one request, on a p2 defence-in-depth card, against a hypothetical non-enforcing backend.

⛔ **No card for C.** You were right not to file it yourself, and right about the reason: it is a design note about this PR's own subject, not an independent defect, and an unpulled exploration should not become backlog weight by default. The limit is stated in the code comment and the PR body, which is where a future reader will meet it.

### Landing

Not governed — `packages/plugin-grid/**` + a test + a changeset, no path hit. So: ready → merge queue **once every check is green**, ⛔ not the required subset.

Read by name just now: **30 checks — 24 success, 3 skipped, 6 `in_progress` (Lint, `Test (shard 1–4/4)`, Type Check), 0 failure.** ⛔ `in_progress` is not a pass. Holding the enqueue until that converges; I will not flip ready before it.
